map.由线性衰减系数与厚度求透射强度: Find the transmitted intensity from the linear attenuation coefficient and thickness
map.输入初始强度 I₀、衰减系数 μ、厚度 x，求透射强度。: Enter the initial intensity I₀, the attenuation coefficient μ and the thickness x to get the transmitted intensity.
map.📖 查看「由线性衰减系数与厚度求透射强度 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the transmitted intensity from the linear attenuation coefficient and thickness"
map.📚 深度解析：γ 射线指数衰减: 📚 Deep Dive: Exponential attenuation of gamma rays
map.I = I₀·e^(−μx) 穿过厚度 x 的屏蔽后强度。: I = I₀·e^(-μx) is the intensity remaining after a shield of thickness x.
map.对比不同线性衰减系数 μ 的效果。: Compare the effect of different linear attenuation coefficients μ.
map.若 x=10cm，则 I=100×e⁻¹≈36.79，厚度翻倍强度降到约 37%: If x = 10 cm, then I = 100 x e⁻¹ ≈ 36.79; doubling the thickness drops the intensity to about 37%.
map.线性衰减系数（cm⁻¹），与材料和射线能量有关，值越大屏蔽越强。: The linear attenuation coefficient in cm⁻¹, which depends on the material and the ray energy; a larger value means stronger shielding.
map.半值层怎么算？: How is the half-value layer computed?
map.半值层 x₁/₂ = ln2/μ，本例 μ=0.1 时约 6.93cm。: The half-value layer is x₁/₂ = ln2/μ, about 6.93 cm when μ = 0.1 as in this example.
